request.style: English, epic orchestral ballad, strong regal female vocal, full string orchestra, French horns, oud, frame drums, harp, timpani, building from intrigue to courage, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
An orphan girl in Susa, raised by Mordecai's hand
Was chosen for the palace, crowned a queen at the king's command
But Haman cast the lot and had the king's decree sent out
To wipe away the Jews in every province round about

[Verse]
Mordecai sat at the gate in sackcloth and in tears
He sent his word to Esther and he would not spare her fears
Do not imagine that you alone of all the Jews will escape
Because you are in the king's house

[Chorus]
If you keep silent at a time like this
Relief and deliverance will arise for the Jews from another place
And who knows?
Perhaps you have come to the throne
For just such a time as this

[Bridge]
Go, gather all the Jews in Susa and fast for me
Then I will go to the king, even though it is against the law
And if I perish, I perish

[Verse]
On the third day in royal robes she stood before the throne
The whole court held its breath to see if she would stand alone
The king held out the golden scepter, she found favor in his eyes
And on the gallows Haman built, the wicked Haman died

[Chorus]
If you keep silent at a time like this
Relief and deliverance will arise for the Jews from another place
And who knows?
Perhaps you have come to the throne
For just such a time as this

[Outro]
If I perish, I perish
For just such a time as this
